pages.lesson:
LESSON: BIBLE STORY: HOLY BIBLE

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The
Topic 2.2: Bible Story: Holy Bible

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Bible Story: Holy Bible. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. narrate the story of David and 6 lessons on God in their day to day lives
2. appreciate the story of David and Goliath in their lives by having faith in God

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. narrate the story of David and 6 lessons on God in their day to day lives
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to narrate the story of David and 6 lessons on God in their day to day lives. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate the story of David and Goliath in their lives by having faith in God
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the story of David and Goliath in their lives by having faith in God. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Bible Story: Holy Bible.
2. Explain Bible Story: Holy Bible to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Bible Story: Holy Bible.
4. Show that you can: narrate the story of David and 6 lessons on God in their day to day lives
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Bible Story: Holy Bible. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Bible Story: Holy Bible important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. narrate the story of David and 6 lessons on God in their day to day lives
2. appreciate the story of David and Goliath in their lives by having faith in God

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
